brief:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called Thursday for an emergency gathering of Organisation of Islamic Cooperation foreign ministers to address the Gaza situation, Middle East Eye reported. Araghchi requested that OIC Secretary General convene the urgent session of member states' top diplomats.

The appeal reflects Iran's effort to mobilize multilateral Islamic diplomatic pressure on the escalating Gaza crisis through the 57-member bloc's institutional channels.
